comments.body:
This is only a configuration issue.
The problem for both running a fcrepo-webapp-plus locally, or via vagrant is that the following system property must be set as follows when using authorization:

JAVA_OPTS="${JAVA_OPTS} -Dfcrepo.modeshape.configuration=classpath:/config/servlet-auth/repository.json"
Nick Ruest or Jared Whiklo can you review today?

Partially resolved with: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant/commit/f6417307b05c351497876ee560fb9c8fb652eced

Andrew Woods do we need a master branch PR too, or is it just for the 4.6.0-RC branch?

Yes, we need a related PR for master... which will include re-introducing a repository.json for AuthZ.
I will have something for you shortly.

Targeting fcrepo4-vagrant master:

  • DO NOT commit until some time in the future, when fcrepo4-vagrant is configured for Fedora 4.7.0
  • https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant/pull/53

Targeting fcrepo4 master:

  • Ready for immediate merging with master
  • https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1090
The above fcrepo4 master PR is ready for you Nick Ruest.
Closing this ticket and creating follow-on: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2116
